title: Ruthless Dulce De Tobacco Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Dulce De Tobacco by Ruthless takes classic Tobacco and gives it a luxurious dessert-inspired twist. The rich, earthy warmth of Tobacco is softened by layers of silky-smooth Caramel and a velvety Milkshake base, creating a vape that’s both bold and indulgently creamy. This unique combination makes for a deeply satisfying and well-balanced flavour that’s perfect for vapers who enjoy tobacco blends with a touch of sweetness. One of many outstanding flavours from American vape juice pioneers, Ruthless, Dulce De Tobacco features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a smooth, well-rounded inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their nicotine strength. For over a decade, Ruthless has been pushing the boundaries of flavour, creating bold and complex e-liquids that remain a favourite among discerning vapers. Their commitment to quality and expertly crafted blends ensures a premium vaping experience in every bottle.
